// Every marked line must produce a real compiler diagnostic, not an unused
// suppression. The harness verifies diagnostic lines as well as nonzero exit.
import { action, TokamakClient, createFunctions, type Id } from '@tokamak/sdk';
import { machines } from '@tokamak/sdk/unstable';
import { api } from '../feature/_generated/api';
import schema from '../feature/schema';
declare const client: TokamakClient;
declare const taskId: Id<'tasks'>;
declare const projectId: Id<'projects'>;
client.mutation(api.tasks.add, { title: 1, priority: 1 }); // reject
client.mutation(api.tasks.add, { title: 'x' }); // reject
client.mutation(api.tasks.add, { title: 'x', priority: 1, extra: true }); // reject
client.query(api.tasks.add, { title: 'x', priority: 1 }); // reject
client.mutation(api.tasks.get, { id: taskId }); // reject
client.subscribe(api.tasks.add, { title: 'x', priority: 1 }, () => {}); // reject
client.query(api.tasks.get, { id: projectId }); // reject
const wrongResult: Promise<number> = client.mutation(api.tasks.add, { title: 'x', priority: 1 }); // reject
api.tasks.constant; // reject
api.tasks.missing; // reject
const { query, mutation } = createFunctions(schema);
query({ handler: ctx => ctx.db.insert('tasks', { title: 'x', done: false, priority: 1 }) }); // reject
query({ handler: ctx => ctx.db.query('missing').collect() }); // reject
query({ handler: ctx => ctx.db.query('tasks').where('done', '=', 'yes').collect() }); // reject
query({ handler: ctx => ctx.db.query('tasks').where('absent', '=', 1).collect() }); // reject
query({ handler: ctx => ctx.db.query('tasks').order('random').collect() }); // reject
query({ handler: ctx => ctx.db.query('tasks').where('priority', '>', 1).collect() }); // reject
mutation({ handler: ctx => ctx.db.insert('tasks', { title: 'x', done: false }) }); // reject
mutation({ handler: ctx => ctx.db.patch(taskId, { done: 'yes' }) }); // reject
mutation({ handler: ctx => ctx.db.replace(taskId, { title: 'x' }) }); // reject

query({ handler: ctx => ctx.machines }); // reject
mutation({ handler: ctx => ctx.machines }); // reject
action({ handler: ctx => ctx.machines }); // reject

query({ handler: ctx => machines(ctx).create({ name: 'forbidden' }) }); // reject
mutation({ handler: ctx => machines(ctx).create({ name: 'forbidden' }) }); // reject

action({
  on: "caller",
  handler: async (ctx) => {
    ctx.machines; // reject
    await machines(ctx).list();
    await machines(ctx).create({ name: "forbidden" }); // reject
    await machines(ctx).remove(null as never); // reject
    await machines(ctx).waitOnline(null as never); // reject
    await machines(ctx).listAll(); // reject
    await ctx.server.url(); // reject
  },
});
